newsitem.title: USA: Grey wins HFS agency of record account.
newsitem.headline: Grey wins HFS agency of record account.

text.p: Grey Advertising Inc said Friday that HFS Inc has picked Grey to be its agency of record, awarding Grey its $100 million consolidated multi-media account.
The account encompasses HFS's hotel/motel chains, including the Ramada, Days Inn, Super 8, Howard Johnson, Knights Inn, Villager Lodge and Wingate Inn chains.
It also includes real estate companies, including the CENTURY 21 and Coldwell Banker brands and the Avis Rent-a-Car franchise system.
Grey will handle television, radio, outdoor and print ads and also coordinate HFS' minority marketing efforts with a yet-to-be-determined minority advertising agency.
HFS is a global provider of real estate and travel services.
Grey Advertising is ranked as the seventh-largest advertising agency in the world.
